decision: Functional cases follow Sam's extension 「延續到上線」 in AGENTS.md (#395). purpose: Verify the seven approved AP tables, the four permissions and their system-admin grants, goods receipt references and reservations, invoice and payment balance constraints, immutable audit records, and the installed Business Master impact checker.
data: Two cases on the ordinary migrated MySQL fixture. The first reads schema and grants. The second inserts up to two synthetic invoices, two payments, a receipt-line reservation and one audit row in a rolled-back transaction, and probes rejected writes with foreign key checks disabled only on that connection.
thresholds: Both cases pass. Exact schema, authorization, constraint, audit and checker assertions. Existing coverage floors remain in place.
trigger: Existing ci.yml functional server MySQL shards for admitted PRs and main. Same discovery, workers, jobs and schedule.
cost: Two added serial cases in the existing shard. Combined related local validation ran 26 cases in 9 to 10 seconds per timezone. CI time has not been measured.

cases: AP installs exactly seven tables and grants the four permissions only to system-admin
AP balances, invoice reservations, and audit immutability survive direct SQL writes
